task: Remove legacy Swift automatic validation from Lattice CLI gates and make lattice.config.json the canonical project config while preserving koala.config.json compatibility.
outcome: User runs `koala validate --json` in a repo that still has Package.swift but no current validator and sees provider `koala-verifier-no-validation-entry` with no `swift test` command; user then adds `lattice.config.json` with validate.commands and sees `koala-verifier-configured-commands` run that configured command. Existing repos with only `koala.config.json` still validate, with diagnostics marking it as legacy fallback.
facts: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts currently discovers fallback commands and adds swift test when Package.swift exists.
packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts currently reports swift test as a discovered fallback label when Package.swift exists.
docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md currently documents swift test as an automatic fallback command.
Koala repo still has Package.swift but B-1691 established the current product surface as Lattice CLI JSON dispatch_run/overflow_auto, not Mac Native App/Swift.
bin/koala.js in Koala can run the Orchestrate CLI engine, so Orchestrate core behavior affects Koala validation gates.
constraints: Do not remove historical Swift source/tests or historical story evidence; only remove Swift as current automatic validation gate.
Swift must remain explicitly runnable through validate.command(s) for legacy projects that opt in.
lattice.config.json must be canonical, but koala.config.json must remain a legacy fallback to avoid breaking existing repos.
Conflict behavior must be visible: lattice.config.json wins over koala.config.json and diagnostics should explain that.
Claude Code is execution host only; Lattice keeps lifecycle/gate authority.
